name: feature-graph
description: Multi-repo feature graph for an APPROVED plan: parallel per-repo implement+verify (local only, no commits) → independent code + security review per repo, round 1 on a different model family from the author, then alternating families in fresh contexts until both reviewers have 2 clean rounds in a row (max 10) → cross-repo contract check → consolidated ready-to-ship data. args: { goal: string, plan: string (approved plan text, e.g. output of `dev-harness handoff show`), repos: [{ path, repo, branch, base? }], authorFamily?: 'claude'|'gpt', devModel?: string (default claude-opus-5.5), reviewModel?: string (default gpt-6.1-sol), altModel?: string (default devModel), maxRounds?: number (default 10), cleanRoundsToStop?: number (default 2) }
